learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the fun things we see at a fair, the exciting rides, and how people enjoy spending time together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A fair is a big, colorful place with lots of shops, exciting games, and happy people. It is a place where families go to have a great time together!
Fairs have big rides like the giant wheel and merry-go-rounds. Going up and down on these swings gives us a super tickly feeling in our tummies!
At the fair, we can eat sweet cotton candy, tasty snacks, and buy bright balloons. There are so many wonderful toys to see and choose from!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Design Your Own Fair!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a huge fair on a paper. Add your favorite colorful rides, a balloon seller, and you holding a yummy treat!

quick_recap: ⭐ A fair is a wonderful place full of games, rides, and food.
⭐ Families and friends visit fairs to have lots of fun together.
⭐ We ride swings, eat delicious treats, and buy toys at the fair.
